Kill [[Maximilian the Meticulous]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Maximilian_the_Meticulous|Maximilian the Meticulous]] in [[Nebo Terrace (War in Kryta)|Nebo Terrace]]
* *BONUS* Kill Maximilian the Meticulous in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 3 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 1 War Supplies

== Walkthrough ==

Exit [[Bergen Hot Springs]] and follow the northwesterly route to Maximilian. If you can tackle the [[undead]] just outside the springs, the rest of the journey should be uneventful. However, if the Skeleton rangers give you trouble, you could start from [[Beetletun]] instead, taking a longer route to avoid tackling the larger groups.

You can use any party that works well in the [[War in Kryta]], although [[holy damage]] (e.g. through [[Smiting Prayers]]) is useful against the undead along the route. [[Frozen Soil]] will help by preventing [[White Mantle]]/[[Peacekeeper]] groups from resurrecting (but remember to avoid using it when the foes are the undead).
